verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Storage for Firebase as a product secured by Firebase Security Rules (granular access control over which users can access data), supported in the Local Emulator Suite and usable as a Cloud Functions trigger source. Community users corroborate storage and storage rules being part of the toolset. However, the evidence never explicitly describes the upload or serve workflow, and says nothing about CDN-backed delivery of stored files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of file upload and download/serve APIs, any evidence of CDN-backed delivery for user files, and hands-on corroboration of file serving.
